stories.title: Exclusive | Anthropic Researcher Quits Over ‘Out-of-Control’ AI Fears
stories.simple_summary: A researcher at Anthropic, a company that makes AI, quit their job because they're worried that AI is becoming too powerful and not controlled properly.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people working in AI companies — it signals concerns about AI safety, but doesn't directly affect your daily life or small business right now.

stories.title: Take on your most ambitious work with GPT-6 Astra on Amazon Bedrock
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is offering a new AI tool called GPT-6 Astra through its cloud services, saying it can help people do more ambitious work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Amazon's cloud services for your business, this gives you a new option, but most small businesses don't use these services yet.

stories.title: US accuses Chinese AI firms of 'malicious' copying of AI technology
stories.simple_summary: The US government says Chinese AI companies are copying AI technology from American companies without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a political and business story between governments and large companies — it doesn't directly affect small business owners.

stories.title: OpenAI claims to have solved maths problem that stumped humans for decades
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI says their AI solved a very difficult math problem that humans haven't been able to solve for decades.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to mathematicians and academics — it doesn't change anything for ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
stories.simple_summary: Hackers have found a way to steal login tokens (like stolen keys) from Claude AI users, letting them use someone else's account without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude AI, you should check your account for unusual activity and consider changing your password, just like you would with any online account.

stories.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
stories.simple_summary: A company called Cognition that makes AI coding tools is now valued at $48 billion by investors, showing that investors think there will be multiple successful AI coding companies instead of just one winner.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to do, though it shows AI coding tools will likely keep improving and competing for your attention.

stories.title: OpenAI Says It Has Cracked One of Math’s ‘Millennium Problems’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI solved one of mathematics' hardest unsolved problems, called a 'Millennium Problem'.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for mathematicians and researchers — it doesn't affect daily life or small business operations.

stories.title: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI says it used AI to solve a difficult math problem that stumped humans for 90 years, doing it in just 88 hours.
stories.why_it_matters: This is exciting for mathematicians and researchers, but doesn't change anything for regular people or small business owners yet.

stories.title: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced that its AI solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a 90-year-old math puzzle about how liquids flow, though some people are questioning the details of this claim.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to scientists and mathematicians — it doesn't affect small businesses or daily life.

stories.title: ChatGPT Sketch turns your bad drawings into detailed AI images
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT added a new feature called Sketch that lets you draw a quick doodle inside ChatGPT and have the AI turn it into a detailed picture based on your description.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT and like creating images, this gives you a simpler way to describe what you want without typing as much.

stories.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) created a new personal AI assistant called Muse that wants access to your email, calendar, payments, and health information to help you with tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: Before using Muse, think carefully about whether you trust Meta with this personal information — it's a choice you'd make yourself, not something required.

stories.title: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
stories.simple_summary: Meta is launching Muse, a personal AI assistant, as part of a big effort to catch up with other companies in the AI race.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows Meta is investing heavily in AI to stay competitive, but whether you'd actually use it depends on whether you trust the company and find it useful.
